title: Beds before frost
note: A short invented chat. Scored spellings are in the replaced turns. One spelling is only in the kept tail.

messages.content: The beds have to be ready before the frost.
The soil test came back at pH 6.4. Sow the broad beans in bed 2.
Order the seed from Marsh Seed, not from the supermarket tray.
Marsh Seed it is. I am skipping the supermarket tray. The row is labelled E4.
A strip of copper tape goes around bed 2.
I will check the row next week.
